to: Kongregate developer/publishing team via the public developer channel
subject: HTML5 review: Paint Blast — Drag to paint — fill 80% of the canvas to win
body:
Hello Kongregate review team,

I am submitting Paint Blast for an initial editorial/technical fit review. It is a self-contained HTML5 game: Drag to paint — fill 80% of the canvas to win. The live build is https://hfo-games.pages.dev/games/010_paint_blast/.

Why it may fit Kongregate: community-friendly replayable HTML5 gameplay and readiness to follow the portal's current integration and monetization requirements. The package is a short-session, dependency-free browser build with a prepared cover image and screenshot. No portal submission, SDK call, ad integration, or external post was performed by the staging run.

This is not an isolated prototype. The full, no-login portfolio at https://hfo-games.pages.dev/ contains 21 live HTML5 titles. Four distinct Suika DLC deployments are also available for comparison: https://hfo-suika-dlc-1-norse.pages.dev/, https://hfo-suika-dlc-2-crystal.pages.dev/, https://hfo-suika-dlc-3-yinyang.pages.dev/, https://hfo-suika-dlc-4-alchemy.pages.dev/. I am highlighting Paint Blast because its other loop is more legible than sending an indiscriminate catalogue dump.

Would you route this build to the appropriate HTML5 review path and name any required integration changes? If the answer is no, a short reason—gameplay fit, polish, performance, SDK, or catalogue overlap—would be useful feedback.

— TTaoGaming
https://github.com/TTaoGaming
canon_priority_note: Poki is low-priority per Sigrun V3; staged because the operator explicitly included Poki as a source. Approve selectively.
